summary: Test suite is critically incomplete. labeler.test.ts provides reasonable coverage for the core assignLabels() function (single glob matching, multiple labels, priority conflicts, error cases), but the suite completely fails to meet three explicit requirements: (1) NO tests run through `act` (requirement: 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT'), (2) NO app.ts integration tests (config loading, CLI parsing, JSON error handling, output format), (3) workflow.test.ts references `fixtures/case1-docs.json` and `fixtures/case2-mixed.json` that don't exist. Workflow tests only check YAML structure and actionlint, not actual execution—no code captures act output to act-result.txt, no assertions on 'Job succeeded', no exact value matching of workflow outputs. Missing: app CLI error cases (missing config path, invalid JSON, malformed config structure), fixture setup, end-to-end workflow execution, edge cases in pattern matching (regex chars, empty labels, basename vs full-path), and any way to verify the solution actually works in GitHub Actions.
